serverZone.name: US Central time
serverZone.basis: Players report the Americas server clock as US Central, and it has been seen twice, both in standard time: the weekly fishing contest (Sunday 14:00 in the game's calendar data) began about 20:00 UTC on November 8, 2026, which is 14:00 Central time, and on November 7 a player in Pacific time saw the game's clock two hours ahead of theirs (11:22 against 9:22 PM, UTC-6). Blizzard has not said, and daylight saving time has not been seen.

serverZone.name: Central European time
serverZone.basis: The weekly fishing contest (Sunday 14:00 in the game's calendar data) began about 13:00 UTC on November 8, 2026 in Europe, which is 14:00 Central European time. Seen once; Blizzard has not said.

events.name: Darkmoon Faire
events.zone: Elwynn Forest, or at the foot of Thunder Bluff (it alternates)
events.repeats: About once a month, on dates set in the game's calendar data: from a Monday at 04:00 server time, for 7 days. The place alternates between Elwynn Forest and Thunder Bluff.

us.basis: The dates and hours are the game's own calendar data, which gives them in server time. The Americas server clock is read as US Central time: players say so, and it has been seen twice, both in standard time: the weekly fishing contest (Sunday 14:00 in that data) began about 20:00 UTC on November 8, 2026, which is 14:00 Central, and on November 7 a player in Pacific time saw the game's clock two hours ahead of theirs (UTC-6). Blizzard has not said. Whether these servers change their clocks for daylight saving time has not been seen yet; times from March 14, 2027 assume they do.

eu.basis: The dates and hours are the game's own calendar data, which gives them in server time. The European server clock is read as Central European time: the weekly fishing contest (Sunday 14:00 in that data) began about 13:00 UTC on November 8, 2026, which is 14:00 Central European time. Seen once; Blizzard has not said. Whether these servers change their clocks for summer time has not been seen yet; times from March 28, 2027 assume they do.
